title: verifiable-gates — a rule catalogue where every rule carries the incident that produced it
description:
A registry of CI gates for software projects built with or without AI coding agents, and the rules behind them as an agent skill. Each of the 92 rules records the incident that produced it, so a reader can judge whether the conditions that produced it still hold; a rule with no incident is a preference, and preferences do not earn a gate.

The bundle ships nine standalone checkers that decide part of the catalogue mechanically in a project that has installed nothing, an installer and a doctor that run them, and a renderer that turns the catalogue into rule sheets an AI coding agent can be handed; the other rules are written for an agent to read. A rule and its enforcement are kept in separate files because they have separate lifetimes. The reference implementation the rules were extracted from is held to every rule published here, and a test in that project checks both directions. The code is Apache-2.0; the rule catalogue and the documentation are CC BY 4.0.
